notes.title: ExitZone – Teaser Trailer is Here! 🚪🔥
notes.content:
[h1]ExitZone – Teaser Trailer is Here! 🚪🔥[/h1][h2]The first official look into ExitZone has just dropped![/h2]
We are excited to finally reveal the [b]Teaser Trailer[/b] for our upcoming survival horror game [b]ExitZone[/b]. Step into the unknown, face terrifying challenges, and discover what lies beyond the Exit…
[previewyoutube=OkyjmTZHE7s;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready, because [b]Early Access launches in September 2025[/b]. This is only the beginning – more reveals and updates are coming soon.

- Team Galactic Games
